content: The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific use. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not substitute for the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If your doctor has prescribed this medication for long-term use, periodic laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., magnesium blood levels, vitamin B-12 levels) may be necessary to monitor your condition and ensure the medication's safety and efficacy. Be sure to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from moisture. Do not open the packets until you are ready to use the medication. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Adding plans allows you to compare formulary status with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you are sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
